C08-M06-L08-F1.title: The intel lab route: from feed match to released note
C08-M06-L08-F1.caption: The lab's seven stages, the kit or lab script behind each, and the loop that sends a draft back until the pre-share check is clear.
C08-M06-L08-F1.alt: Top-to-bottom graph. Match (ioc_match.py against minisiem.db) leads to Verify sightings (minisiem.py search on raw events), then Grade (intel_grade.py: reliability + credibility), then Age (validity at three check dates), then Derive first-party IOCs (R3 and R4 hits: domain, account), then Draft note (attacker-side facts, TLP per item), then Scrub check (scrub_check.py). From Scrub check a dashed arrow labelled findings greater than 0 returns to Draft note. A solid arrow labelled 0 findings leads to two outputs: TLP:GREEN peer note (first-party plus GREEN items), shown in green, and TLP:AMBER sighting to ISAC-A (asks permission to widen), shown in dark.

nodes.label: Derive first-party IOCs
nodes.sub: R3 and R4 hits: domain, account

C08-M06-L08-F1.note: A match is where the lab starts, not where it ends: every indicator is verified, graded and aged before anything is shared.

C08-M06-L08-F2.title: Graded and aged: the five feed indicators after the lab
C08-M06-L08-F2.caption: Real intel_grade.py results for each indicator, with the analyst's final decision on how to use it.
C08-M06-L08-F2.alt: Table with columns Indicator, Sightings and rule, Grade, Valid on 16 Nov, Decision. cdn-telemetry-sync.example: 18 sightings, rule R6, grade B1 HIGH, valid (45 days left), decision: block, hunt, AMBER sighting to ISAC-A; red row. banyan-payroll-update.example: 1 sighting, no rule, grade B3 MEDIUM upgraded to B2 by the analyst, valid (14 days), decision: block, share as first-party; orange row. 203.0.113.66: 9 sightings, rule R2, grade B1 HIGH, expired after 10 November, decision: retire block, keep for retro search; violet row. 198.51.100.104: 1 sighting, no rule, C3 LOW expired, decision: no action, flag as stale; slate row. 9f2c...e1a0 hash: no telemetry, B6 ungraded, valid (76 days), decision: close the telemetry gap; blue row.
C08-M06-L08-F2.note: Grades and ages come from the script; the right-hand column is the analyst's judgement and must be written down with its reason.
